'EmailVerificationConfirmPanel does not overflow in Hebrew (RTL) — the '
        'former H1 action-Row overflow',

why: I ran the H1 test with `skip: true` removed (scratch copy, `flutter test ... --plain-name H1`) and it passes today. The sibling overflow-matrix test in this same batch (email_verification_confirm_panel_overflow_test.dart) independently confirms the RTL Row overflow was fixed by wrapping the button labels in Flexible+ellipsis, and its own docstring calls it 'the former H1 action-Row overflow.' The skip and its bug description in email_verification_confirm_panel_test.dart were simply never cleaned up after the fix landed, so a real, currently-passing RTL layout+content assertion sits permanently disabled.
recommendation: Remove skip: true and the stale BUG comment from the H1 test.
acceptance_criteria: H1 in email_verification_confirm_panel_test.dart runs (no skip) and passes in CI.
